unlock_rewards_matched_to_native_command.native_command_source: チームプレイ方針徹底

adjacent_event_context.goal_source: 一定以上のチーム総得点
adjacent_event_context.goal_detail_source: 野手コーチの提案で走塁の新しいトレーニングを導入することにした。果たして選手たちへの効果はどうだろうか。
adjacent_event_context.english_goal_detail: The fielding coach suggested a new baserunning drill. Let's see how much it helps the team.
adjacent_event_context.deepl_goal_detail: Based on a suggestion from the fielding coach, we decided to introduce a new baserunning training regimen. I wonder how effective it will be for the players.

adjacent_event_context.goal_detail_source: 投手陣の不調が問題となっている。本社は戦力を放出してのトレードも画策中のようだ。まだ優勝が狙えるチームだと証明せねば。
adjacent_event_context.english_goal_detail: Our pitchers are struggling, and ownership is considering a trade. Show them this roster can still contend.
adjacent_event_context.deepl_goal_detail: The pitching staff’s slump has become a problem. Headquarters appears to be planning trades that would involve releasing players. We must prove that this team can still contend for the championship.

adjacent_event_context.goal_source: 一定以下のチーム総失点
adjacent_event_context.english_goal: Keep runs allowed within the limit
adjacent_event_context.goal_detail_source: 最近若い投手達が同じような冊子を持っているのに気付き、話を聞くと「コーチに貰った教材だ」と言う。良い効果が出ることを期待しよう。
adjacent_event_context.english_goal_detail: The young pitchers are studying a booklet from their coach. Let's see if the lessons show up on the field.
adjacent_event_context.deepl_goal_detail: I recently noticed that some young pitchers have similar booklets, and when I asked them about it, they said, “Our coach gave them to us as study materials.” Let’s hope this has a positive effect.

adjacent_event_context.goal_detail_source: 一時離脱せざるを得なくなった@t選手。早期復帰をめざしている彼を安心させるためにも、チーム一丸で穴を埋めねば。
adjacent_event_context.english_goal_detail: @t is working to return soon. The whole team needs to fill that player's shoes in the meantime.
adjacent_event_context.deepl_goal_detail: Player @t has been forced to take a temporary leave of absence. To reassure him as he aims for an early return, the team must pull together to fill the gap.

adjacent_event_context.goal_source: 期間試合中１登板以上で・８奪三振以上
adjacent_event_context.english_goal: 1+ appearances and 8+ K in this stretch
adjacent_event_context.goal_detail_source: @t選手ですが、ここまで力強い投球で、三振の山を築いています。力ある投手の証でもある奪三振。このタイトルも狙えるか。
adjacent_event_context.english_goal_detail: @t has racked up strikeouts with overpowering stuff. Can that arm take the league strikeout title?
adjacent_event_context.deepl_goal_detail: @t has been pitching with such power so far, racking up a mountain of strikeouts. Strikeouts are a hallmark of a powerful pitcher. Could he be in the running for this title as well?

adjacent_event_context.goal_source: 期間中試合Ｘ０．５回以上を投げ、１失点以内
adjacent_event_context.english_goal: 0.5+ IP/game; allow at most 1 run total
adjacent_event_context.goal_detail_source: 安定したマウンドさばきでチーム内の選手からの信頼も勝ち取りつつある@t選手。投げるほど信頼は増していくことでしょう。
adjacent_event_context.english_goal_detail: @t is earning the clubhouse's trust with steady work on the mound. Each outing is another chance to build on it.
adjacent_event_context.deepl_goal_detail: Player @t is gradually earning the trust of his teammates with his steady performance on the mound. The more he pitches, the more that trust is sure to grow.

adjacent_event_context.goal_source: 一定回数流し方向へ打つ
adjacent_event_context.goal_detail_source: コースによって広角に打ち分けないと強い打球を飛ばすことができません。あえて流し打ちを徹底させ、アウトコースのボールの対応を練習させます。
adjacent_event_context.english_goal_detail: Use the whole field to drive pitches in different locations. Practice hitting outside pitches the other way.
adjacent_event_context.deepl_goal_detail: Depending on the pitch, players cannot hit the ball hard unless they adjust their swing to hit to different parts of the field. We deliberately focus on teaching players to hit the ball to the opposite field and have them practice handling pitches on the outside corner.

adjacent_event_context.goal_source: 一定回数引っ張り方向へ打つ
adjacent_event_context.goal_detail_source: 打球を強く叩かせるために、引っ張りを意識させた早い始動を身につけさせます。内角の速球にも差し込まれない力強いスイングをめざします。
adjacent_event_context.english_goal_detail: Start the swing earlier and work on pulling the ball. A strong swing can turn on a fastball inside.
adjacent_event_context.deepl_goal_detail: To help players hit the ball with more power, we’ll teach them to initiate their swing early while focusing on pulling the ball. The goal is to develop a powerful swing that won’t be overpowered even by fastballs on the inside corner.

review_decisions: Use Fielding Coach and Coach Capacity consistently with the current interface and official role terminology.
Cash assistance adds money to a player trade; the unlocked command is Add Cash to Trade.
The rehabilitation unlock corresponds to the existing Specialist Treatment command.
Strikeouts and appearances in event 122 are totals across the stated event period, not an eight-strikeout requirement for every appearance.
Event 138 combines an innings-per-game threshold with no more than one total run allowed during the period.
Opposite-field and pull-side contact targets do not add an unsupported requirement for base hits.
Retain total bases rather than DeepL interpretations involving triples, extra-base-hit counts or base-hit counts.
Preserve runs versus RBI, hits versus times on base, innings versus appearances, and all decimal batting/OBP thresholds.
Preserve the inclusive 0.7/0.3/0.5/0.6 ratios and the 1/2/4/5/7/8 numeric targets.
Keep manager-command unlocks distinct from form recovery, fatigue recovery, Awakening and MCP ranges.

wording_follow_ups.source_introduction: まもなく迎えるスターたちの夢の競演・オールスター。@nこの晴れの舞台にわがチームからも@v@t@vが出場することとなった。出場するだけでも素晴らしいことだが、どうせならば@vチームの代表として恥ずかしくない結果も残してきてほしい。@v@f何はともあれ、怪我無くもどってきてくれることが一番大事なことではあるが…
wording_follow_ups.source_success_story: 喧騒の中、表彰台に立つ@v@t@v。@n誇らしげに堂々とインタビューを受けるさまはチームの一員として見ていて嬉しくなると同時に誇らしくなる。@n今回の経験は彼にとっても大きな自信になっただろう。@fシーズン後半戦が始まったあとも、きっと彼は素晴らしい活躍をしてくれるに違いない。@n大いに期待しよう。
wording_follow_ups.issue: The native text establishes an All-Star award/podium, but does not explicitly name MVP. The actual native success predicate still needs inspection. No wording change is made in this pass.
wording_follow_ups.resolution: The original event 5 objective explicitly says to win All-Star MVP; current goal and award-story wording are corroborated.
